title: [CI] Fold report tools into main build and publish packaged apps in one MSBuild call

review.body_prefix:
### Qualified current-revision assessment

The report tools remain part of the main solution, and the aggregate project still publishes the same seven packaging projects with the existing child properties. This revision removes the obsolete standalone solutions, their extra CI verifier calls, redundant build documentation and historical comments, as requested in the maintainer review. No caller should keep relying on those deleted solutions.

The latest author reply answers the maintainer's history question: this was a legacy separation, and the intended direction is solution filters and simpler shared builds. The recorded changes-requested review has not yet been dismissed, but the author has supplied the requested explanation; it is not a current author-action wait or evidence of a missing payload. Already addressed documentation comments should not be reposted.

**Validation scope:** The complete delta within all eleven current PR files was read, including the removed solutions and references. The aggregate Publish task's functional content is unchanged from the previously exercised fixture; the earlier eight configuration/dispatch checks retain their original revision identities. No current real application publish, native report-tool build, installer packaging or Azure template expansion was executed. This is a qualified source reassessment, not unconditional approval.

**Latest context:** The maintainer's legacy-build-history question was answered by the author. The undismissed recorded review is not evidence that the author still owes that explanation. Current description measurements remain author evidence, not an independently repeated full packaging run.
